page.overview:
Who is Stripevincible?

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother)

Big Mildew (attempted victim) Business Baby (attempted victim) Angstrom Levy (former ally)

Stripevincible is a supporting antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 3. He is an evil variant of main Invincible from another universe, where he rules over the Viltrum Empire.

Stripevincible was assembled by Angstrom Levy to help start the Invincible War in the mainstream dimension. After the war, he and the surviving variants turned on Angstrom for breaking their deal and were subsequently banished to the Wasteland Universe.
